component.name: DeepComplex
component.summary: Configure DPI, RGB lighting, buttons, macros, and 5 profiles for Delux M700A
تخصيص سرعات DPI والإضاءة والأزرار والماكرو و5 بروفايلات لماوس Delux M700A
Настройка DPI, RGB-подсветки, кнопок, макросов и 5 профилей для мыши Delux M700A
为 Delux M700A 鼠标配置 DPI、RGB 灯效、按键、宏和 5 组配置文件

description.p: DeepComplex is an open-source Linux controller built with Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami for the Delux M700A (Instant A725 / USB 30FA:1040) gaming mouse.

ul.li: 5 independent software profiles with JSON backup and restore
6 customizable DPI levels (200–7200 DPI) with per-level indicator colors and live auto-sync
14 onboard RGB lighting modes including Reactive and 6-zone Extra Mode color mapping
Hardware Macro Studio with layout-independent key capture and multimedia key bindings
Strict default Flatpak sandbox isolation with transparent permission risk ratings, command breakdown, and XDG Background Portal autostart

description.p: Added security risk ratings and detailed risk notes for every permission and command, fixed onboarding step navigation, added system tray opt-in hint, About card, USB hardware modalias, and GPL-3.0-or-later LICENSE file.
